svg.title: 02 | Containers - Campus Workshop Board
svg.desc: Expands: Campus Workshop Board (01-context). Proposed technologies; external API contracts are design assumptions.

text.tspan: Expands: Campus Workshop Board (01-context). Proposed technologies; external API contracts are design assumptions.
Server-rendered HTML; authentication and owner checks;
workshop creation, publishing, reads and reservations;
requests confirmation only after committing a new seat.
Transactions, row locks and unique constraints.
PostgreSQL wire protocol / TCP (TLS in deployment):
parameterized SQL, transactions, locks; stored rows / commit result
Session: signed, expiring HttpOnly cookie containing the verified profile; Identity Gate checks signature and expiry on every board request.
Durable domain data lives in Board Database, not process memory; refresh performs a new stored-state query. [R1, R5]
Legend: blue = application container; green = person or data-store container (type shown); grey = external system.
Dashed outline = system boundary; arrows = requests/dependencies, with response data included in the label. HTTPS = encrypted HTTP.
